faq.q: What kinds of land does the Cloverdale feed actually show?
faq.a: All three board sub-areas and several products at once: serviced infill lots in the Cloverdale sub-area, Clayton parcels including a North Clayton holding, and Serpentine-labelled farm acreage — every visible card is labelled Land and Active, spanning $799,000 to $8,720,000 on the first page, as a snapshot at reading.

faq.q: How do I check a Cloverdale lot's zoning and subdivision potential?
faq.a: In the City of Surrey's COSMOS mapping — the route the live page itself gives — for the lot's current zoning, OCP designation, secondary plan status, water/sanitary/storm main locations, road dedications and riparian setbacks; use current zone names, since the July 8, 2024 SSMUH changes replaced RF-12/RF-12C with R4 and RF-SD with R6.

faq.q: Can I subdivide or build a second home on a Cloverdale ALR parcel?
faq.a: Subdivision of ALR land requires Agricultural Land Commission permission outside limited regulation exceptions; for housing, the ALC frame allows a principal residence capped at 500 m² with any suite inside it, plus at most one additional residence of 90 m² (parcels ≤40 ha) or 186 m² (>40 ha), where City bylaws also permit it.
